title: It is a symbol of Irish art. The cracked looking-glass of a servant
html_source:
Or rather, the art of the colonized and subjugated Irish.

The “cracked looking-glass” is an image from Oscar Wilde’s essay “The Decay of Lying.” Stephen adds to the image by reducing it to the status of servant’s possession, as he feels Ireland has been.

Joyce favoured being part of all nations rather than one and putting art before a nation (Cheng,V. Joyce, Race, and Empire, p66).
